features: 🔊 RIDHAM 2.0 – 100W Bass Boost Party Blaster- UPGRADED 2026 AUDIO CIRCUIT: Engineered with a next-generation internal circuit board that delivers crystal-clear audio, minimizes distortion at peak volumes, and ensures highly efficient power management for long party hours. Introducing the latest version of the hot-seller RIDHAM speaker, now upgraded with an 8-inch woofer for thunderous bass. With 100W output, it delivers powerful sound perfect for home parties, dance sessions, and indoor entertainment.

📦 Solid MDF Cabinet with Dual Midrange Speakers Built for superior sound clarity, this speaker features a durable MDF cabinet housing one 8-inch woofer and two 4-inch midrange speakers. Get deep bass, balanced mids, and clear treble in a compact, stylish form.

🎵 All-in-One Music Playback: AUX, USB, FM & SD Enjoy complete plug-and-play convenience with support for Pen Drive, SD Card, FM Radio, and MIC. Easily connect via AUX to your TV, Laptop, Guitar, or any audio source for versatile music experiences.

🎤 Supports Wired Microphone – Karaoke Ready Turn any space into a mini concert. The RIDHAM 2.0 supports wired microphones for karaoke nights or announcements, making it ideal for parties, get-togethers, and events in compact indoor spaces.

🇮🇳 Made in India – Perfect for 250–300 Sq. Ft. Rooms Proudly manufactured in India, this speaker is optimized for indoor spaces of 250–300 square feet, offering immersive sound without overwhelming the room. A must-have for music lovers and party hosts.

MONSTER 100W OUTPUT & THUMPING BASS: Experience studio-grade sound with a powerful 100W peak output; the dedicated heavy-bass subwoofer driver punches out deep, rich, and vibrating low-end frequencies perfect for Bollywood and EDM tracks.
